title: Analysis of self-thermalization dynamics in the Bose-Hubbard model by using the pseudoclassical approach
summary: We analyze the self-thermalization dynamics of the $M$-site Bose-Hubbard model in ring geometry using the single-particle density matrix calculated via the pseudoclassical approach. We show that a weak inter-particle interaction, which has a negligible effect on the thermal state given by the Bose-Einstein distribution, suffices to convert the integrable system of non-interacting bosons into a chaotic system.
